notes: All 26 pages were inspected as individual rendered page images. After the abstract wording change, page 1 was inspected again. Render hashes confirm that pages 2 to 26 did not change.

The 48-trial table on page 21 fits the page. All 12 site-rule-view rows and all eight column labels are visible.

The D03 images retain the search fields, controls, table rows, total counts, and pagination needed for interpretation. Their top crop edges show part of an unrelated page text line. This minor crop detail does not remove task evidence. The evidence images were not changed.
References 15 to 17 are complete and readable on page 26. Reference numbering continues correctly from page 25.
This review was performed by an AI agent. No human review or external peer review is claimed.
